observation.command:
COOKIE=/tmp/op3.txt
rm -f $COOKIE
curl -s -c $COOKIE http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/lp.html
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/lp.html | tail -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b $COOKIE -c $COOKIE -o /tmp/lr.html -w "login POST HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "username=admin" \
  --data-urlencode "password=AdminPass12345!" \
  http://localhost:8080/login
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/lr.html | head -1
echo "=== authenticated request ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE -o /tmp/acct2.html -w "account HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/my/account
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/acct2.html | head -1
curl -s -b $COOKIE -H "Accept: application/json" http://localhost:8080/api/v3/users/me | head -c 300
